title: Wife Sets Husband's Home On Fire to 'Rekindle' Their Marriage: Cops
description:
Bodycam footage shows Homosassa, Florida police responding to a house fire allegedly set by 40-year-old Melissa Dunham, who was found near the scene carrying lighter fluid. Officers detained both Melissa and her estranged husband Josh Dunham as investigators worked to piece together what happened. Watch the incident unfold on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
